about: The words of the page shell: the name and its lines, the dateline, the ears, the footer, who made the site. Read by admin/build/lib/config.mjs; the shell (admin/build/lib/shell.mjs) only places them. The name is PrompTugal.news, with a capital P and T (the brand identity v2.0, Dinis Cruz, 5 November 2026; before it PromptUGAL, and the working name The Lisbon Wire): change it here and nowhere else. The masthead is the brand's outlined wordmark (assets/brand/), never the name set in type.
